tonight.headline: Two moves before Thursday night, and neither costs priority
body: Week 3 has not started. JuiceJam project 131.6 to your 119.6 on the back of Gibbs and Walker, and ESPN gives you 45%. Your lineup is 0.2 below the projection lineup, and the gap is Golden versus Vele in the flex.
Before Golden locks tomorrow at 18:15, decide the flex. Before Sunday, add Gadsden for Stafford. Don't spend waiver priority tonight: the Carnell Tate fallback from this afternoon is withdrawn.

case.label: Where the gap is
case.body: JuiceJam's two backs project 46.5 between them against your 38.1. You can't close that with a lineup change. You can close the 0.2 in the flex, and you can protect the tight-end slot.

case.label: The unknown
case.body: Chicago's quarterback. Caleb Williams didn't practise Wednesday (hamstring), Tyson Bagent is in concussion protocol and away from the facility, and Ben Johnson said he's 'not sure who the starter's going to be on Monday night' (SI). Chicago practise again Friday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Nico Collins (questionable) is ruled out and JuiceJam have no receiver to replace him. The gap then falls to single digits and your flex choice matters more than this brief assumes.

doFirst.title: Start Devaughn Vele in the flex, bench Matthew Golden
doFirst.subtitle: A coin flip. Take the projection — 11.6 to 11.4 — and don't read anything into it.

case.label: Why this is a coin flip
case.body: The lineup check scores them 11.6 to 11.4 on projection and 10 to 9 on Week 2 opportunities. Standing policy for a coin flip: take the projection, no thesis, no log entry.

case.label: What reporting adds
case.body: Golden has 18 targets through two games, 12 then 6 (Fox Sports 1070), and Green Bay start Thursday without WR Jayden Reed and two offensive-line starters (CBS). Vele is 'the clear WR2' in New Orleans with 12 catches on 16 targets (FantasyPros), and Tyler Shough has been a top-8 quarterback two weeks running (Fantasy Footballers). Neither is a role fact strong enough to overrule the projection.

case.label: This afternoon's brief said the opposite
case.body: It kept Golden on routes and targets. That's the analysis-of-noise the coin-flip rule exists to stop. I'm taking the projection, not claiming to know better.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Nothing about the result would prove it. A coin flip that loses is still a coin flip. The rule is what's being tested: wrong if over the season coin-flip calls made by projection underperform the alternative by a clear margin.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Los Angeles kick off Sunday 11:00 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Add Oronde Gadsden II, drop Matthew Stafford
doFirst.subtitle: Carried over from this afternoon and re-checked. Gadsden is a free agent, so it costs no priority. Stafford is a backup quarterback who can't score for you: IPADE starts one quarterback and the flex doesn't take one.

case.label: The player
case.body: RotoWire: Gadsden is the Chargers' only healthy tight end — David Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) are expected to go on injured reserve. Buffalo have allowed 14 catches for 116 yards and a TD to tight ends in two games.

case.label: Why a second tight end here
case.body: IPADE's flex (slot 23) takes a tight end, and your starter Loveland may be catching passes from Case Keenum on Monday. Gadsden plays Sunday, so he's the insurance that decides before Chicago's answer does.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Stafford projects 14.8 but can only ever play if Lawrence misses. A free-agent quarterback — Tyler Shough is available at 17.7 — covers that week at no cost. Shough's own case is in Do not chase.

case.label: Honest weakness
case.body: ESPN projects Gadsden 8.7 to Loveland's 9.7. On numbers alone this is a downgrade. It's justified only by the quarterback risk in Chicago.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gadsden draws under four targets against Buffalo with the room ahead of him empty, or Chicago clear Caleb Williams to full practice — then the option was bought and not needed, at the cost of a player who couldn't play anyway.

action.label: Add Oronde Gadsden II · drop Matthew Stafford

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — decide Saturday, before Gadsden's 11:00 Sunday kickoff
doFirst.title: If Chicago name Keenum, start Gadsden at tight end over Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: Unarmed. Only fire this if Williams is ruled out or listed doubtful on Saturday. Needs the Gadsden add above first.

case.label: The evidence so far
case.body: Williams didn't practise Wednesday; he did the walkthrough. Bagent is in protocol and not at the facility. Keenum practised and ESPN report he is 'ready to start if called'. Chicago don't practise Thursday, so Friday and Saturday decide it.

case.label: The cost of waiting
case.body: None. Gadsden plays Sunday at 11:00 and Loveland not until Monday, so Saturday's report arrives before either locks.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Williams is a full participant Friday or Saturday. The card then never fires and costs nothing.

whatWentWrong.title: The flex was defended on targets when it should have been set by projection
whatWentWrong.lead: This afternoon's brief held Golden over Vele on routes and targets. The lineup check calls it a coin flip, and the rule for a coin flip is the projection.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: The IPADE quarterback slot lost 42.8 points in two weeks to confident reasoning about close calls. A 0.2 gap is exactly where that reasoning is least reliable.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coin-flip calls made by projection keep losing to the discarded option across the season. Then the rule needs a volume tiebreak.

whatWentWrong.title: The defence you are starting lost its best pass-rusher today
whatWentWrong.lead: Brian Burns will miss Week 3 with a low ankle sprain (Yardbarker). The Giants hold said a pass-rusher on the report would prove it wrong.

case.label: Why it is still a hold
case.body: The best free-agent alternative, Carolina, projects 7.3 to the Giants' 7.1, and Carolina are without Devin Lloyd and Jaelan Phillips. Two tenths of a point isn't worth a move on a seat that changed on Wednesday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Carolina's defenders return Friday and the Panthers finish as a top-five defence while the Giants finish outside the top fifteen.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.6 a week. Tuten replaces Rachaad White's 9.4 at RB2, and Lamar Jackson scores them nothing because Josh Allen starts every week.

case.label: Re-checked tonight
case.body: Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0, and Rachaad White still starts at RB2. Recomputed from this snapshot: Bloodsports 119.9 → 123.6, Team 13 123.6 → 125.2.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: On season projection it's lopsided — Lamar 297.3 to Tuten 166.9 — which is why it's rated a longshot. It clears the bar for them only on a weekly lineup view. It also takes Barkley's cover off your roster while Barkley has a stinger.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar appears on a Baltimore injury report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten becomes a starter. Don't re-send; reply only if they open the conversation.

trades.copyText: Hi — would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar is behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White — about +1.6 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver taking targets from your own starter, and a free agent here.

case.label: The role
case.body: CBS: six catches on a team-high 12 targets in Week 2, 29.3% of Geno Smith's 41 attempts, and 'an upside WR3/4' against Detroit's depleted secondary.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: He wouldn't start over Vele or Golden. The only seat is Coleman's, and that changed hands on Tuesday.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Coleman is ruled out on Friday, add Mitchell for him — free, no priority. Wrong if Wilson goes over nine targets at Detroit and Mitchell under six.

worthALook.name: Carnell Tate
worthALook.lead: This afternoon's fallback card, withdrawn. Still the biggest ownership gap on this wire.

case.label: What changed
case.body: Week 2 was 3 catches on 5 targets for 27 yards (NBC) — a smaller role than the 23.8% adjusted share this afternoon's card relied on. He's on waivers until 01:00 Mexico City tonight, and claiming him would cost priority that never resets, for a WR5.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If he clears to free agency and Coleman is ruled out, he's the second choice for that seat after Mitchell. Never as a claim.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: ESPN: Carolina 7.3, Giants 7.1. FantasyPros have Carolina DST2 at Cleveland, but Lloyd, Phillips and Scott didn't practise Wednesday. The Giants lost Brian Burns for the week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Lloyd and Phillips practise fully on Friday. Then it's a free swap, and the Giants seat was changed on Wednesday by an add, not a claim.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: Projects above Lawrence and is a free agent, and he is still the wrong move for this slot.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Fantasy Footballers: a top-8 QB in both weeks with five total touchdowns. ESPN projects him 17.7 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: His case rests on two box scores, and this QB slot lost 42.8 points in two weeks by chasing box scores. The Raiders have allowed one passing TD all season. The only free seat, Stafford's, is committed to Gadsden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence gets hurt, or Chicago clear Caleb Williams — which frees Stafford's seat from the Gadsden insurance.

doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, with a rising number that comes from one injured game.

case.label: The fact
case.body: FantasyPros: 13 carries for 33 yards and a TD while Barkley played 16% of Week 2 snaps. Sirianni expects Barkley to play through the stinger.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for Monday. Even then Tuten starts first, and Bigsby would need a seat that doesn't exist.
